attribution: Nutrition facts as published by each chain for this market (see source per item). Chain and product names are trademarks of their owners; Kandro is not affiliated with any chain.

chains.name: Burger King
chains.sourceTitle: Burger King UK – Nutritional Information (Country report: United Kingdom, June 2026)
chains.notes: burgerking.co.uk/nutritional-info (linked from the site) redirects to an official Google Drive PDF 'BKGUK13189-BKG Kit 6 Digital Nutrition' – Country report: United Kingdom, printed June 2026, control version Kit 6 National 18.06.2026 V1. The PDF is image-only; values were read visually from 2.2x renders and each cross-checked against Atwater. Per-serving values with published serving weights (g). Column 'Total Carbohydrates' (US-style; fibre listed separately, likely included in carbs). The PDF has NO drinks section, so no drinks/zero-kcal drink are included. Big King was dropped: its published 1402 kcal contradicts its own 3416 kJ (=816 kcal). '<0.5' values (fries sugar, 6pc nugget fibre) omitted. Breakfast King / Sausage items not tagged pork because the PDF gives no ingredient detail for the sausage patty.

chains.name: Costa Coffee
chains.sourceTitle: Costa Coffee UK – In-store allergen & nutrition guide (valid 22 Oct 2026 – 6 Jan 2027)
chains.notes: Per-portion values from the official UK in-store guide (festive edition, PDF created 15 Sep 2026; costa.co.uk/docs/store-allergen-guide.pdf embeds the Sanity CDN file). Festive/seasonal items excluded. Drinks: standard recipe, Signature blend; drink tables have no fibre column. Oat latte is made with oat drink (dairy alternative) but not tagged vegan since Costa notes shared equipment. Vegetarian/vegan tags for food from the guide's Dietary Choices columns.

chains.name: Five Guys
chains.sourceTitle: Five Guys UK – Nutrition Guide, UK locations only (FGUK_20261013)
chains.notes: Official 'UK Nutrition & Allergen Guide' PDF linked from fiveguys.co.uk (section 'NUTRITION GUIDE - UK LOCATIONS ONLY', version FGUK_20261013). Typical values per serving as published (per-100 g also published, but no serving weight, so servingG omitted). The 'Northern Ireland' guide (EURO-FGI-FOH12, for Benelux/IRE/NIR/AT/SWE/ITA) was NOT used. Burgers = 2 patties, 'Little' = 1 patty; values as published for the standard build (toppings not itemised). Fries are cooked in peanut oil. Coffees/tea are marked '*participating locations only'. Freestyle soft drinks are not in the guide ('check the machine screen/bottle label'), so there is no ≤5 kcal soft drink; Breakfast Tea (6 kcal) is the lowest. Excluded: Little Bacon Burger (carbs printed as 367 g, a source typo), Americano White (per-serving row all zeros, inconsistent with its per-100 g row), Heathrow-only breakfast items, milkshake mix-ins.

chains.name: Greggs
chains.notes: Values per portion as published on greggs.com product pages; the site loads them from Greggs' own article API (second source URL), read 2026-10-25. servingG is the published article size (g, or ml for drinks). Greggs publishes no fibre value, so fibre is omitted. Pizza values are per single slice as sold. Hot Food lines (goujons, wedges, toasties, soup) are not sold in every shop. lactose-free tag set only where the item's allergen list on the same official API lists no Milk. Sausage items tagged pork (Greggs' pork-free alternative is the separately named Vegan Roll Pork-Free).

chains.name: itsu
chains.sourceTitle: itsu – menu product pages (nutrition per item)
chains.notes: Values per item as displayed on each itsu.com menu product page (kcal shown next to the product name; nutrition table without portion weight, so servingG omitted). Data read from the page's embedded server-rendered state (same values as rendered table). itsu latte/flat white pages list ~1 kcal (apparently coffee-only, without milk) and were excluded as implausible. Fibre is listed separately (EU labelling). Vegetarian/vegan tags based on the published ingredient lists; lactose-free only where neither allergens nor may-contain list milk.

chains.name: KFC
chains.sourceTitle: KFC UK & Ireland – Allergen & Nutrition Information September 2026 (PDF)
chains.notes: Values per serving as listed in the official KFC UK&I allergen & nutrition PDF 'September 2026' (print code KFC5201~61253_W9_26_ALG; file last-modified 05 Oct 2026). kfc.co.uk web pages return 403 (Akamai) to curl, WebFetch and the browser, so the PDF on KFC's own asset host is the source. No fibre and no portion weights are published, so fiber/servingG are omitted. Vegetarian/vegan tags follow the PDF columns (note: KFC fries are NOT vegetarian per the PDF – shared fryer). Hot Wing sugar is published as '<0.5' and omitted. 'Bottle of Still Water' is listed with 0 kcal but '0.5' g macros (KFC's '<0.5' convention). Items marked Ireland-only (#/~) and the 'Limited Time Offer' section were excluded. 'Tender' is listed in the PDF as 'Tender (per piece, average)'. lactose-free only on drinks: KFC states it cannot guarantee food is free of milk traces.

chains.name: LEON
chains.notes: Per-portion values and total portion weight as published on leon.co/menu item pages (UK), read from the site's menu data on 2026-10-25; only items linked from the current menu category pages were used. Carbohydrates exclude fibre. Vegan/vegetarian tags from LEON's own dietary labels; pork/pork-free from LEON's published ingredient lists; lactose-free only where LEON's allergen list shows no milk and the ingredient list has no dairy. Breakfast items are served until 11am.

chains.name: McDonald's
chains.notes: Per-portion values read from the official UK product-page data feed (dnaapp itemDetails, country=UK) that mcdonalds.com/gb product pages load; fetched in a browser on 2026-10-25 (curl is blocked by Akamai). Portion weight is not published as grams in the feed (only per-portion and per-100 g values), so servingG is omitted. UK carbs exclude fibre. Drink sizes per the product slug (Medium/Regular). The Crispy Sweet Chilli Chicken Wrap ('The One' range) may rotate. Allergen field in the feed is unreliable (lists all 14 allergens for many items), so no lactose-free tags were set. Item IDs: Big Mac 200211, QPC 200212, Fries M 200145, etc.

chains.name: Nando's
chains.notes: REVIEW BEFORE USE. The live UK menu page (nandos.co.uk/food/menu, read 2026-10-25) publishes only kcal per item. Full macros come from Nando's own menu data file on the same site (page-data.json, served by nandos.co.uk but with Last-Modified 17 Jan 2022), which no longer matches the current menu for most dishes (e.g. 1/4 Chicken 284 vs 289 kcal live, Grilled Chicken Wrap 537 vs 514). Only items whose kcal in that file exactly equals the kcal on today's live menu were kept, on the assumption that the recipe is unchanged; all other dishes (quarter/half chicken, burgers, wraps, pittas, most sides) were dropped. Chicken values are 'on its own' (no sides, plain baste as published). Lactose-free only where Nando's allergen data says milk 'NO' (cross-contamination 'maybe' does not count). Drop this file if a current-only standard is required.

chains.name: PizzaExpress
chains.sourceTitle: PizzaExpress – Nutritional Information, England, Wales & Scotland (September 2026)
chains.notes: Per-portion values from the official England, Wales & Scotland nutrition PDF (September 2026) linked on pizzaexpress.com/allergens-and-nutritionals. Restaurant (dine-in) versions; "Dine Out"/delivery and gluten-free variants not included. Portion weights are not published (only per-100 g columns), so servingG omitted. Classic and Romana are different bases; Leggera are the lighter pizzas with salad centre. Airport-only breakfast menu excluded. Vegan tag only where the dish name says vegan (the nutrition PDF has no vegetarian column, so no vegetarian tags otherwise); pork-free only for clearly meat-free dishes; pork tag for pepperoni/ham pizzas (American, La Reine).

chains.name: Pret A Manger
chains.sourceTitle: Pret A Manger UK – product nutrition (pret.co.uk)
chains.notes: Per-serving values (and average weight in g/ml) as shown on pret.co.uk/en-GB product pages; read from the page data of the UK menu category pages on 2026-10-25. Carbohydrates exclude fibre (UK label convention). Vegetarian/vegan tags from Pret's own suitableForVegetarians/suitableForVegans flags; lactose-free only where Pret's allergen list shows no Milk; pork-free only where the published ingredient list contains no pork/bacon/ham/gelatine. Coffee values are for the standard Pret recipe with semi-skimmed/dairy milk as published. Some items (super plates, protein plates, hot food) are not sold in every shop.

chains.name: Starbucks
chains.sourceTitle: Starbucks UK – Nutrition & Allergen Guide (Autumn 2026, food v05/10/26; beverages v18/09/26)
chains.notes: Per-portion values from the official UK food and beverage guides linked on starbucks.co.uk/nutrition. Portion weights are not published, so servingG omitted. Beverages: standard recipe, Signature Espresso; Grande size. Fibre given separately (EU). Seasonal items excluded. Vegetarian/vegan from the guide's Suitable for Vegetarian/Vegan columns; lactose-free only where vegan and no MILK in the ingredient declaration.

chains.name: Subway
chains.sourceTitle: Subway UK & ROI – Nutrition Information September 2026 (PDF)
chains.notes: Official 'Nutrition Information September 2026 – UK and ROI' PDF linked from subway.com/en-gb/menunutrition/nutrition (fetched via WebFetch; direct curl to media.subway.com timed out). Per-serving values with published serving weights. Subs are 6-inch and, per the PDF, calculated as bread (bread type not stated) + protein + onions, cucumbers and lettuce – no cheese or sauce; double for a footlong. Salads/wraps per the PDF sections. UK carbs exclude fibre. The PDF has no drinks section, so no drinks are included. The Beef Chilli salad row duplicates the Chicken and Bacon salad row in the source (likely an error) and was not used. Halal protein variants exist in some stores and differ slightly.

chains.name: wagamama
chains.notes: Per-serving values from the official UK menu data embedded in wagamama.com/menu (menu '07/10/2026 - UK - main website', modified 2026-10-16), read 2026-10-25. Dish names kept in wagamama's own lower-case style. No serving weights are published, so servingG is omitted. Carbohydrates exclude fibre. Vegan/vegetarian tags from wagamama's own dietary flags; lactose-free only where wagamama's allergen data lists no milk (not even 'may contain'). Coffee items whose published values were all zero (iced lattes/matcha) were not used.

chains.name: Wasabi
chains.sourceTitle: Wasabi UK – Nutritional information, Version 34 (released 17 Sep 2026)
chains.notes: The guide gives kcal per portion plus all macros per 100 g and the portion size; kcal is the published per-portion figure, protein/carbs/fat/sugar computed = per100g x portion g / 100 (computedFromPer100g). No fibre published. Sushi/donburi/gyoza values are the versions including the supplied dressing/condiments (guide also lists "excl. dressing"). Hot bentos use the bain-marie standard portion (large portions also published). Vegetarian/vegan tags from the guide's Suitable for Vegetarians / Vegan columns; soups on page 12 transcribed from the PDF text.
